name: refugio
description: REFUGIO — a self-hosted refuge for your AI. One command installs a local LLM (Ollama or LM Studio) + Open WebUI, with optional personal connectors (WhatsApp via Hermeneia, email via Epistole, Notion, memory) and business connectors (Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce) via MCP.
author: Dennis Kittrell
